title: ClearPoint-style multi-page marketing site (original content) with resources + contact form

requirements.summary: Create a multi-page marketing site with ClearPoint-like information architecture (original copy/assets), including shared header/nav, footer, and responsive layouts.
acceptanceCriteria: Top-level navigation includes a logo area, primary nav links, and clear calls-to-action similar in placement/behavior to the reference site (e.g., a primary CTA button in the header).
Site includes at least: Home, Platform/Product (or equivalent), Services/Solutions (or equivalent), Resources (blog/articles listing + detail page), About, and Contact pages.
All page layouts are responsive across mobile/tablet/desktop with no horizontal overflow and no broken layouts.
All user-facing text is in English and is original (not copied from the reference site).

file_operations.description: Create the app shell and client-side routing for Home, Platform, Solutions, Resources (list + detail), About, and Contact; ensure route-based rendering supports direct navigation/refresh.
Create a shared layout that renders semantic landmarks (header/nav/main/footer) and consistent max-width/spacing wrappers across pages.

Implement responsive header navigation with logo area, primary links, and a primary CTA button consistent with marketing-site patterns (mobile menu included). Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button, Sheet/Navigation patterns) to accelerate accessible interactions; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement a multi-column footer with secondary navigation, brief company blurb (original), and contact links, matching the overall structure/patterns of the reference site while using original content.
Create the Home page route and wire it into the app router and header navigation.
Create the Platform/Product page with original marketing copy, sections, and reusable layout patterns; wire into router/nav.
Create the Services/Solutions page with original marketing copy and section templates; wire into router/nav.
Create the About page with original copy and consistent section structure; wire into router/nav.
Create the Contact page route and wire it into router/nav; form behavior is implemented under REQ-4.

requirements.summary: Implement a sectioned, scroll-based homepage with hero, social proof, features, testimonial/case-study preview, resources preview, and final CTA band.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage renders a hero section with headline, subheadline, primary CTA, secondary CTA, and a prominent hero visual.
Homepage includes a social-proof/logo strip section.
Homepage includes at least 3 feature/value cards and at least 1 testimonial/case-study style section.
Homepage includes a resources preview section linking to the resources listing page.
Homepage includes a final CTA section above the footer.

file_operations.description: Build the homepage section stack (hero, social proof, feature/value cards, benefits, testimonial/case-study preview, resources preview, final CTA) using original copy and generated images; include responsive typography hierarchy and spacing.

Create a reusable feature/value card grid (≥3 cards) with consistent hover/focus states. Use shadcn-ui Card/Button primitives where helpful; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a testimonial/case-study style section for the homepage, including headshot placeholders and a concise quote layout.
Create a social-proof logo strip section using the generated partner logos strip asset and responsive layout rules.
Add the generated abstract hero illustration as a static frontend asset and reference it from the homepage hero visual.
Add the generated partner logo strip image as a static frontend asset and reference it from the homepage social-proof section.
Add the generated outline feature icons set as a static frontend asset and use it as the icon source for feature/value cards.
Add the generated testimonial headshots strip as a static frontend asset and reference it from testimonial/case-study preview sections.

requirements.summary: Create a Resources area with listing + detail pages using client-side routing and seeded original content with consistent templates and related items.
acceptanceCriteria: Resources listing page shows a grid/list of content cards with cover image, title, short excerpt, and metadata.
Clicking a content card navigates to a detail page with full body content and a consistent layout.
At least 6 sample resources are included as seed content (original text).
Routes work with refresh (direct navigation to a detail URL loads correctly).

file_operations.description: Create seed Resources content (≥6 items) with original English text including slug, title, summary/excerpt, cover image reference, body content, author, date, and tags/related pointers.
Implement the Resources listing page with a responsive grid/list of content cards (cover image, title, excerpt, metadata) and links into the detail route.
Implement the Resources detail page template (title, summary, cover image, body content, author/date) plus a related-items section linking to other seeded resources.

Create a reusable card component for resource summaries with clear hover/focus-visible states. Use shadcn-ui Card/Button primitives where helpful; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a related-items module for the resource detail page that reuses the same card/list styling patterns.
Wire Resources routes into the router (listing and detail) and ensure route matching works on direct navigation/refresh.
Wire the homepage resources preview section to navigate to the Resources listing page and highlight a subset of seeded resources.

requirements.summary: Add a Contact page form with client validation and success/error states, calling the backend to persist submissions (UI should not expose listing).
acceptanceCriteria: Contact form validates required fields and email format on the client.
On submit, the frontend calls the backend to store the submission and shows a success confirmation state.
Backend stores submissions in stable state (survives canister upgrade).
Backend provides at least: createSubmission and listSubmissions endpoints; listSubmissions is not exposed in the UI by default (API only).

file_operations.description: Implement the contact form (name, email, organization, message) with client-side validation, loading state, and success/error confirmation UI; call the backend capability via the typed actor method to save a submission (saveContact) and do not add any UI to list submissions.
Create a hook that uses the existing actor connection to call the backend capability to persist a contact submission, exposing mutation state for UI success/error handling.

Create a small reusable form field wrapper for consistent labels, help text, and error messages. Use shadcn-ui Input/Textarea/Label primitives where helpful; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply site-wide UI polish: consistent widths/typography, hover/focus states, accessible contrast, and subtle scroll-based motion respecting reduced motion.
acceptanceCriteria: Interactive elements (links, buttons, cards) have clear hover and focus-visible states.
Motion is subtle and respects reduced-motion preferences.
Lighthouse-like best practices are followed: no blocking mega-assets; images are optimized and appropriately sized.
All primary pages have consistent max-width, spacing scale, and typography scale.

file_operations.description: Define global typography scale, spacing conventions, focus-visible styling, and base element defaults; ensure no horizontal overflow and consistent section max-width behavior across the site.
Refine Tailwind theme extensions (spacing, typography, shadows) to support a consistent marketing look and reusable section/card styling.
Create a reusable Section wrapper (background variants, padding presets, container sizing) to enforce consistent widths and rhythm across pages.
Implement a lightweight IntersectionObserver-based reveal hook for subtle fade/slide-in animations that respects reduced-motion preferences and avoids performance issues.
Apply consistent section wrappers, hover/focus styles on interactive cards/CTAs, and scroll reveal motion where appropriate without overwhelming the page.
Apply consistent section wrappers, typography hierarchy, and interactive states matching the global styling system.
Apply consistent section wrappers, typography hierarchy, and interactive states matching the global styling system.
Apply consistent section wrappers, typography hierarchy, and interactive states matching the global styling system.
Ensure resource cards are responsive, keyboard accessible, and visually polished with clear focus-visible styling.
Ensure article typography is readable (prose styling), images are sized appropriately, and related items are responsive and accessible.

requirements.summary: Create and apply a cohesive, modern B2B visual theme (not blue/purple-dominant) with consistent colors, typography, and component styles across all pages.
acceptanceCriteria: A consistent theme is applied across all pages (same button styles, heading styles, spacing, and card styles).
Primary palette is not blue/purple-dominant; use an alternative (e.g., charcoal/off-white with green/teal accents).
Typography hierarchy is clear (H1/H2/H3/body) and consistent across pages.

file_operations.description: Define theme tokens using CSS variables (charcoal/off-white base with green/teal accents), set default font stacks, and establish consistent heading/body styles across the app.
Map Tailwind color roles (primary/secondary/accent/background/foreground/card) to the theme tokens to keep component styling consistent and non-blue/purple dominant.

Create composable marketing primitives (e.g., PrimaryButton variant wrapper, Badge, Stat block) that standardize buttons/cards/section accents without modifying immutable UI component files. Use shadcn-ui components by composition; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add route-level SEO + social metadata and enforce accessible semantics (landmarks, headings, alt text).
acceptanceCriteria: Each primary page sets a unique title and meta description.
OpenGraph tags are present and reference a generated OG image asset.
All images have appropriate alt text; pages use semantic headings and landmarks (header/nav/main/footer).

file_operations.description: Add any needed lightweight SEO/head management dependency (e.g., react-helmet-async) and ensure build scripts remain compatible with the existing template.
Create a reusable SEO component to set per-page title/description and OpenGraph tags referencing the static OG image asset.
Add the generated OpenGraph preview image as a static frontend asset and reference it from SEO metadata for primary routes.
Set a unique title/description and OpenGraph metadata via the shared SEO component; ensure hero and section images include descriptive alt text and headings follow a semantic hierarchy.
Set a unique title/description and OpenGraph metadata via the shared SEO component; ensure semantic headings and alt text.
Set a unique title/description and OpenGraph metadata via the shared SEO component; ensure semantic headings and alt text.
Set a unique title/description and OpenGraph metadata via the shared SEO component; ensure resource card images and icons have appropriate alt/aria labeling.
Set a unique title/description and OpenGraph metadata via the shared SEO component; ensure article landmarks and heading structure are accessible.
Set a unique title/description and OpenGraph metadata via the shared SEO component; ensure semantic headings and alt text.
Set a unique title/description and OpenGraph metadata via the shared SEO component; ensure form fields have labels, errors are announced accessibly, and landmarks/headings are semantic.

requirements.summary: Ensure the frontend is runnable and deployable in the template environment with working navigation and end-to-end contact submission wiring.
acceptanceCriteria: Project builds successfully without manual edits.
Navigation between pages works in the deployed environment.
Contact form submission works end-to-end (frontend to backend).

file_operations.description: Ensure all required routes are registered and navigable from the header/footer, with no orphan pages; verify client-side routing works on refresh in the deployed environment configuration.
Verify end-to-end wiring for contact submission using the existing actor connection (useActor) and the save-contact hook; ensure user-visible success/error states are present and stable.
Ensure app providers (query client, identity provider, and any SEO provider if introduced) are correctly composed so the app runs without manual edits.
